title: Define provider response metadata, token usage, reasoning, and tool-call boundaries
description: Rust ChatResponse currently only carries a MessageChain, while AstrBot LLMResponse keeps token usage, reasoning content/signatures, raw completion identity, finish/stop data, and tool-call payloads. Define this response metadata boundary before provider parity, tool orchestration, dashboard trace, and live feedback push those fields into concrete provider adapters or agent runner code.

files.change: Expose metadata, token usage, reasoning, tool-call, and streaming response DTOs without growing ChatResponse directly.
Represent prompt/completion/total tokens and provider-specific usage details outside protocol parsers.
Model reasoning text/signatures and provider thinking config outputs separately from user-visible message chains.
Normalize provider tool-call IDs, names, arguments, partial JSON, and extra content before agent/tool-loop consumption.

criteria: Concrete provider protocol modules do not become the only place that understands reasoning, token usage, and tool-call payload shape.
AgentRunner can forward response metadata without coupling to OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic DTOs.
Future observability/live-feedback code can consume typed provider response metadata.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
